summary: Solaris Resources filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 10, 2026, providing an operational update on its flagship Warintza copper project in southeastern Ecuador. The release covers renewed cooperation agreements with the FISCH and PSHA Indigenous federations, finalization of Community Life Plans by the Warints and Yawi communities, continued permitting progress following technical EIA approval, and ongoing drilling and technical studies. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate action is disclosed. This is a routine project-update current report and does not constitute a special situation.
